description: Zeck environment matrix (Deployment & Runtime Architecture D1.0 section 4). Repository truth: the four logical environment classes, their isolation contract, teardown policy and promotion ladder. Provider consoles cannot redefine this matrix.
note: ci is a check phase on the promotion ladder, not a hosting environment class. The four environment classes are exactly local, preview, staging and production. D-08 (WORK-060 / SEC-003) adds two first-class dimensions to every environment: `region` (the repository-declared data-at-rest region of the environment class — the deployment is single-region per class today; a multi-region production edits this repository truth, never a provider console) and `connectivity` (the closed internal-path vocabulary control-plane/worker communication may use — `public` is unrepresentable by construction).

local.description: Developer workstation control plane with local PostgreSQL, local object-store root and a Redis-compatible coordination service. Fully disposable synthetic state.

preview.description: Isolated per-branch preview deployment. Synthetic or explicitly disposable data only. Preview resources are never implicitly promoted.

staging.description: Production-like topology with isolated credentials and a dedicated database project/branch. Exists to prove production deployment behavior before promotion.

production.description: Authoritative production data and credentials. Requires commercially permitted provider plans and explicit monitoring, backup and rollback procedures.
